title: Serpent & Ivory Spells
description: A nighttime scene at a mystical wooden shop called 'Serpent & Ivory Spells - Elixirs, Scales & Stasis'. A young male shopkeeper in a dark blue robe stands behind the counter handing a glowing vial to a hooded customer, while a massive blue serpent with red eyes coils around the building and tree branches above them.
prompt: A two-story blue wooden shop at night with a large sign reading 'Serpent & Ivory Spells - Elixirs, Scales & Stasis'. A giant blue scaled serpent with glowing red eyes coils around the building and a gnarled tree with hanging tags. Inside the shop window, a young male wizard in a dark robe stands behind a counter filled with potion bottles and glowing papers, handing a small glowing vial to a hooded customer in a brown cloak. Mystical blue smoke and magical symbols float in the air, dark purple cloudy sky, atmospheric fantasy scene.
